name: Unitree G1 humanoid (unitree_sdk2 / UniStore)
bridge: unitree_sdk2 (C++) / unitree_sdk2_python over DDS; store apps via UniStore Developer Center

native.move.navigate_to: LocoClient.Move(vx, vy, vyaw) + your own localization (no built-in named places)
native.arm.handover: G1ArmActionClient preset arm actions (handshake-style); not a grasp
native.safety.speed_limit: cap vx/vy in the adapter (no global limit API assumed)

addon.arm.pick: dexterous hand + your grasp policy (e.g. a LeRobot/GR00T fine-tune): experimental
addon.sense.detect_objects: vision model on the camera stream
addon.gesture.point: arm action or low-level arm control
